title: Nutty Polish Vegetable Skewers
description: A tangy and crunchy Polish dish featuring chili powder and temper, perfect for a vegan-friendly snack or side dish. This recipe combines the flavors of Poland with the energy of fresh vegetables.

ingredients.name: bell peppers
ingredients.notes: any color, sliced into 1 inch pieces

ingredients.name: mushrooms
ingredients.notes: button or cremini, sliced into 1/2 inch thick pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together chili powder, temper, salt, and olive oil.
Add the sliced zucchini, bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the chili powder mixture.
Thread the vegetables onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
While the skewers are baking, mix together chopped peanuts and parsley in a small bowl.
After the skewers have baked for 20 minutes, remove them from the oven and sprinkle with the peanut and parsley mixture.
Return the skewers to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the skewers from the oven and serve hot.
